rejection_summary.title: Sleepy Hollow
rejection_summary.reason: Reviewed as an atmospheric supernatural murder mystery centered on one village and a Headless Horseman. Although the mature tone, witchcraft, and visual craft are strong, independent reviews establish limited invented-world breadth, no developed nonhuman societies or kingdoms, and little sustained fantasy action; not a sufficiently strong match for this high-fantasy profile.

rejection_summary.title: Creature Commandos
rejection_summary.reason: Adult animated monster-team superhero/black-ops action, not a magic-led fantasy world of kingdoms, mythology and developed nonhuman cultures. Reviews also emphasize comic violence and humor rather than the required mature high-fantasy worldbuilding.

rejection_summary.title: Pokémon: Lucario and the Mystery of Mew
rejection_summary.reason: Creature-centered animated family adventure; family-oriented presentation and franchise setting do not support the required mature, serious fantasy tone.
